Set-up a conda environment with all mechGEA dependencies properly installed.

setup_mechGEA_env.Rd

mechGEA can be difficult to properly install given very exact install order requirements to prevent conflicts and bugs on some systems. This function sets up a properly-installed conda/mamba environment for future use.

Usage

setup_mechGEA_env(name = "mechGEA", conda_path = "DEFAULT")

Arguments

name

character, default "mechGEA". Name of the environment to create.

conda_path

character, default "DEFAULT". Path to conda binary. If "DEFAULT", conda_binary will be used to attempt a guess and install if no conda install located.

Value

Generates a conda environment with mechGEA and all dependencies correctly installed. Load with conda activate mechGEA (or whatever name was used during setup) called from the command line.

Author

Eric Robertson

William Hemstrom

Examples

# setup an environment using the default conda path
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
setup_mechGEA_env("mechGEA")

# then, in command line (not R), run:
# conda activate mechGEA
# Rscript /path/to/my/mechGEA/analysis/Rscript.R
} # }
